alerts.label: Need colonist beds
alerts.explanation:
You have more colonists than you have colonist beds. Someone will lack a place to sleep.

Either make more beds, or change a prisoner bed to a colonist bed.

If you have no resources, sleeping spots are free and can be placed instantly.

alerts.label: Need recreation variety
alerts.explanation:
There are only 2 different recreation types available in Colony, but at the current expectations level (very low), colonists need 3 different kinds of recreation to remain satisfied. Provide recreation variety supplying a new, different kind of recreation.

<color=#E6E64CFF>Available recreation types</color>:
  - Solitary relaxation
  - Social interaction

<color=#E6E64CFF>Missing recreation types</color>:
  - Dexterity play
  - Cerebral play
  - Television watching
  - Telescope study
  - Music
  - Chemical consumption
  - Food consumption
  - Reading

Note: You can check the recreation type of any item in its stats page, accessible with the 'i' button.

alerts.label: Medical treatment needed
alerts.explanation:
These people need medical treatment. Without it, they may die of their wounds, or their wounds may become permanent.
  - <color=#D09B61FF>Cline</color>

Treat them by sending them to a medical bed.

(First, assign a medical bed by selecting it and toggling it into a medical bed. Then, select the wounded person and right-click on the medical bed to make them a patient.)

alerts.label: Colonist stuck in a pit
alerts.explanation:
These colonists are down a pit they cannot climb out of, and cannot reach food or a bed:

  - Cline

Lower a ladder into the pit, or dig a ramp out.
